en: Death has lost its victory And the grave has been denied Jesus is forever He's alive

ko: 그는 알파와 오메가, 또 처음과 나중
죄악의 저주 끊고 완전한 자유 주셨네
en: He's the alpha and omega, The first and last The curse of sin is broken, We have perfect liberty
The lamb of God has risen
He's alive, He's alive Hallelujah Jesus is alive
